essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions shaped Europe into rival blocs with competing fears and military pressure.
The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, which escalated through mobilization and declarations of war.
From 1914 to 1918, the war moved from outbreak to U.S. entry to armistice in a basic chronological order.

activities.label: Alliance map
activities.title: Europe before the war
activities.body: Study the short model and note the main cause and tension labels.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions shaped Europe into rival blocs with competing fears and military pressure.

activities.label: Cause explanation
activities.title: Why the crisis spread
activities.body: Answer in your own words. Keep it to causes and sequence.
activities.concept: The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, which escalated through mobilization and declarations of war.
activities.correctAnswer: The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, and the crisis spread as states mobilized and then declared war.
activities.feedback: A complete answer links the assassination to the July Crisis and shows how mobilization and declarations of war widened the conflict. If needed, repair by naming the event first and then the escalation step.

activities.label: Fix the sequence
activities.title: Repair the outbreak chain
activities.body: Revise your answer with the corrected chain. Keep the order exact.
activities.misconceptionSummary: Treating the assassination as the same thing as the wider war outbreak, instead of the trigger for the July Crisis that then escalated into declarations of war.
activities.concept: The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, which escalated through mobilization and declarations of war.
activities.correctAnswer: The assassination was the trigger, then came the July Crisis, then mobilization and declarations of war.
activities.feedback: The key repair is separating trigger from escalation. The assassination starts the crisis; the wider war begins only after the later diplomatic and military steps.

activities.label: Timeline recall
activities.title: WWI from 1914 to 1918
activities.body: Explain the start-to-finish order from memory.
activities.concept: From 1914 to 1918, the war moved from outbreak to U.S. entry to armistice in a basic chronological order.
activities.feedback: A complete answer places the outbreak first, U.S. entry later, and the armistice last. If needed, keep it as a simple three-step timeline.

activities.label: Timeline check
activities.title: Choose the war timeline
activities.body: Pick the best basic order. Use the whole timeline, not just one event.
activities.concept: From 1914 to 1918, the war moved from outbreak to U.S. entry to armistice in a basic chronological order.
choices: Sarajevo assassination, July Crisis, 1914 outbreak, 1917 U.S. entry, 1918 armistice
1918 armistice, 1917 U.S. entry, 1914 outbreak, July Crisis, Sarajevo assassination
1914 outbreak, Sarajevo assassination, July Crisis, 1918 armistice, 1917 U.S. entry
July Crisis, 1914 outbreak, 1918 armistice, Sarajevo assassination, 1917 U.S. entry
activities.correctAnswer: Sarajevo assassination, July Crisis, 1914 outbreak, 1917 U.S. entry, 1918 armistice
activities.feedback: The correct order keeps the trigger, escalation, outbreak, later U.S. entry, and final armistice in sequence. Recognition is not enough by itself, but it confirms the overall timeline.

activities.label: Return point
activities.title: Come back to the timeline
activities.body: Write one thing to review later and one date or event to retell from memory.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: Alliance blocs before war
activities.body: How did prewar European alliances divide the major powers?
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances divided powers into Triple Entente and Triple Alliance blocs.
activities.correctAnswer: They split the major powers into the Triple Entente and the Triple Alliance. These blocs linked states together before the war began.
activities.feedback: This is about bloc formation, not later wartime fighting.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: From Sarajevo to war
activities.body: What chain of events followed the Sarajevo assassination?
activities.concept: The Sarajevo assassination triggered Austria-Hungary's ultimatum and Europe's war declarations.
activities.correctAnswer: The assassination led Austria-Hungary to issue an ultimatum, then war declarations spread across Europe.
activities.feedback: The key link is the escalation from one assassination to wider declarations of war.
